intentEvidence: A useful tool for importing, managing, and rendering Shadowdark RPG monster statblocks directly in your notes.
motivation: To provide GMs with fast workflows, clean formatting, and seamless integration into session preparation.
problem: Manually creating or formatting monster stat blocks from external sources is time-consuming and prone to errors.

relations.evidence: Shadowdark Statblocks can integrate with the Dice Roller plugin to provide clickable attack and damage rolls directly from monster statblocks.

summary: A tool for importing, managing, and rendering Shadowdark RPG monster stat blocks directly into notes for fast campaign preparation.
